release_purpose: Frozen research inputs and replaceable examples, not final design
hourly_timebase: local standard time, 1-hour intervals; timestamp labels start of interval
load_data: synthetic, fixed seed/profile mapping, not measured
pv_data: NASA-based model DC production / 5.22 kWp; not measured; shared profile
physical_soc_formula: 1 - (4.325 * modules - Store_kWh) / (5.12 * modules); coordinate assumption, not measured SOC
store_timestamp: end of interval; previous interval state is start; cyclic source year
grid_export_policy: zero in supplied cases; not legal determination
economics_status: historical model costs; not actual bills, excludes unpriced infrastructure and AC feeder losses
GIS_context: Transformer points filtered to allowed set; retained original mapped lines/poles are context, not validated service routes or evidence of permitted connections
critical_load_split: parked; optional separately labelled hypothetical sensitivity
